More frequently updated, spatially granular complementary evidence is therefore needed to identify where socioeconomic conditions may be changing between survey rounds and to inform operational prioritization. Earth observation and machine learning offer a scalable source of spatially explicit socioeconomic information. However, tools developed for general populations have not been systematically adapted and evaluated in forced displacement settings, where living conditions, settlement patterns, and displacement impacts may differ substantially. We address this gap by adapting a multimodal spatiotemporal vision transformer, pretrained on Demographic and Health Survey data from approximately 1.2 million households across 36 African countries, to forced displacement and host community settings in South Sudan, Cameroon, and Zambia. We develop and evaluate the updated, adapted model using socioeconomic indices derived from UNHCR FDS and RMS data. Our results show that satellite-derived geospatial covariates explain up to 66% of the variation in socioeconomic outcomes in camp-intersecting grids, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 4.37 index points, and 41% in non-camp-intersecting areas, with an MAE of 5.41. The framework complements and adds value to periodic household surveys by filling critical spatial and temporal data gaps with regularly updated, model-based socioeconomic estimates. These estimates sustain insight between survey rounds and support timely humanitarian prioritization and field verification.

</details>


### [459] [Bellman Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15987)
*Zhuoqing Song,Haotian Xu,Xikun Zhang,Lidong Bing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO)，一种无需 Critic 的强化学习方法，基于 Policy Mirror Descent (PMD) 并利用 Bellman 方程将 PMD 重构为轨迹级目标，避免中间状态价值估计，证明与原 PMD 具有相同唯一最优解，实验在数学推理基准上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽能提升大语言模型推理能力，但传统方法需估计中间状态价值，引入额外复杂度和偏差。本文旨在提出一种无需 Critic 的方法，直接利用终端奖励优化自回归生成策略。

Method: 基于 Policy Mirror Descent (PMD)，利用 Bellman 方程将目标重构为轨迹级目标，避免中间状态价值估计。推导实用 BPO 损失函数，其 mismatch-correction 权重为互补 Token 概率的平滑比率。

Result: 理论证明 BPO 目标与原 PMD 具有相同唯一最优解；实验在数学推理基准（如 GSM8K, MATH 等）上显示 BPO 优于基线方法。

Conclusion: BPO 作为一种无需 Critic 的强化学习方法，通过 Bellman 方程重构 PMD，简化训练并保持理论最优性，在数学推理任务上表现优异，为大语言模型推理能力提升提供新思路。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). We introduce Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free method derived from Policy Mirror Descent (PMD). For autoregressive generation with terminal rewards, BPO uses the Bellman equations to reformulate PMD as a trajectory-level objective. The reformulation avoids estimating state values at intermediate states. We prove that it has the same unique optimal solution as the original PMD objective. We derive the practical BPO loss by approximating this objective. Its mismatch-correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of BPO.

</details>


### [460] [MoveBench: A Benchmark for Global-Scale Wildlife Movement Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15780)
*Justin Kay,Shir Bar,Ellen O. Aikens,Martin Becker,Francesca Cagnacci,Juliet Cohen,Scott W. Forrest,Jessica Kendall-Bar,Madeleine Lucas,Macon Overcast,Meredith S. Palmer,Will Rogers,Nicholas J. Russo,Christian Rutz,Larissa T. Beumer,Michael Brown,Ying-Chi Chan,Sarah C. Davidson,Diego Ellis Soto,Anne G. Hertel,Roland Kays,Benjamin Koger,Guram Mikaberidze,Thomas Mueller,Ruth Oliver,Thorsten Papenbrock,Robert Patchett,Jared A. Stabach,Dane Taylor,Scott W. Yanco,Sara Beery*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoveBench 是首个大规模概率性野生动物运动预测基准，包含 260 万 GPS 位置、800 多个个体、110 物种、127 国家及 16 亿环境栅格瓦片（160 协变量），并提出概率评估协议；实证评估显示：方法对未来时间点泛化优于未见个体，深度学习不稳定优于简单基线，环境协变量选择显著影响性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解和预测野生动物运动对生态学和保护至关重要。现有轨迹预测多针对人类和车辆，野生动物轨迹具有空间无约束、高度随机、受环境条件影响大等特点，缺乏标准化的大规模基准和概率性评估体系。

Method: 构建 MoveBench 基准：收集 260 万 GPS 记录（800+ 个体、110 物种、127 国家），配对 16 亿环境栅格瓦片（160 个已知或假设影响运动的协变量）。提出概率性评估协议，解决点预测指标对随机现象的局限。对四类方法家族在多时空尺度上进行全面实证评估。

Result: 三大发现：(1) 现有预测方法对未来时间点的泛化能力优于对未见个体的泛化；(2) 深度学习方法并不稳定优于简单基线；(3) 环境协变量的选择对预测性能有显著影响。

Conclusion: MoveBench 为运动预测方法提供了标准化评估平台，并为这一生态学关键任务的方法学进步奠定基础。

Abstract: Understanding and predicting wildlife movement is critical for ecology and conservation. While trajectory forecasting has advanced for human and vehicle movement, wildlife trajectories present distinct challenges: they are unconstrained in space, highly stochastic, and influenced by environmental conditions. We introduce MoveBench, the first large-scale benchmark for probabilistic wildlife movement forecasting, containing 2.6M GPS locations from 800+ individuals across 110 species in 127 countries, paired with 1.6B environmental raster tiles capturing 160 covariates known or hypothesized to influence movement. We propose a probabilistic evaluation protocol for movement trajectory forecasts, addressing limitations of point-prediction metrics for inherently stochastic phenomena. Through comprehensive empirical evaluation of four method families across multiple temporal and spatial scales, we reveal that: (1) existing predictive methods generalize better to future timepoints than to unseen individuals, (2) deep learning approaches do not consistently outperform simpler baselines, and (3) environmental covariate selection significantly impacts performance. MoveBench enables standardized evaluation of movement forecasting methods and provides a foundation for methodological advances on this ecologically important task.

</details>


### [461] [Sharp Rates and a One-Line Correction for Spectral Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15825)
*Dier Tang,Jing Yee Tan,Guangyue Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究自监督预训练编码器冻结后通过轻量探针迁移至未见任务的性能，指出各向同性假设是错误的，任务协方差与跨视图依赖算子奇异方向的对齐度决定迁移风险，提出对齐系数A_k和诊断方法，证明一行重加权可恢复最优性，实验验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践者需要知道何时现成特征足够好、何时需修复；现有理论基于各向同性先验，但实际任务先验有方向性偏好，需量化对齐程度并给出诊断与修正方案。

Method: 分析任务协方差Λ在跨视图依赖算子前k奇异子空间上的压缩，定义对齐系数A_k，推导最坏遗憾界1-1/κ(Λ)及精细界1-A_k，证明遗憾定域于top-2k子空间，在谱隙下为二阶；给出O(k d_x^2)统计量计算对齐，误报时用正样本对加权一行代码修正。

Result: 证明对齐是泛化的：高维下非相干偏好抵消，T个多样任务迫使α=Õ(√(d_x/T))，定量解释任务多样性而非对称性使特征可迁移；诊断器能从小标注预算回答实践者问题，拒绝不支持宽度的任务库；受控数据上遗憾从0.86降至0.003，CIFAR-100编码器正确预测无需修正。

Conclusion: 任务先验的各向同性非必要，关键在于任务协方差主方向与依赖算子奇异谱的对齐顺序；提出的对齐诊断与一行重加权修正提供了实用的迁移学习理论与工具。

Abstract: A self-supervised encoder is trained once, frozen, and reused through lightweight probes on tasks nobody named at training time; the practitioner's question is when the off-the-shelf features are good enough and when they need fixing. Canonical correlation analysis, HGR maximal correlation, and the population optimum of the spectral contrastive loss all return the top-$k$ singular subspace of a cross-view dependence operator, justified by isotropy: if the task prior has no directional preference, that subspace is universally optimal. We show isotropy is the wrong hypothesis. The prior enters the transfer risk only through the task covariance $Λ=\mathbb{E}[ΔΔ^\top]$, and only through its compression onto the operator's leading singular directions; what matters is not whether $Λ$ is isotropic but whether its preferred directions are ordered consistently with the operator's spectrum. We prove matching two-sided rates---worst-case regret is exactly $1-1/κ(Λ)$, refines to $1-A_k$ for an alignment coefficient $A_k$, localizes to the top-$2k$ subspace, becomes second order under a spectral gap, and is improvable by no task-agnostic representation---and show why alignment is generic: incoherent preferences cancel in high dimension, and $T$ diverse tasks force $α=\widetilde O(\sqrt{d_x/T})$, a quantitative account of why task diversity, not symmetry, makes self-supervised features transfer. The governing statistics cost $O(kd_x^2)$, and when they signal misalignment a one-line reweighting of the positive-pair term provably restores exact optimality. The result is a diagnostic that answers the practitioner's question from a small labelled budget and refuses when the task bank cannot support the width requested; on controlled data it takes a regret of $0.86$ down to $0.003$, and on a CIFAR-100 encoder it correctly predicts that no correction is needed.

</details>


### [462] [Per-Matrix Optimality Is Not Enough: Three-Level Optimization for Low-Rank LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15838)
*Huicheng Zhang,Xiyao Feng,Ze-Tong Li,Chengkai Zhu,Xiao Shi,Xiwei Pan,Jinguo Liu,Ge Bai,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种三级优化链（L1 白化 SVD、L2 块级联合优化、L3 端到端语言建模损失微调），用于在仅使用 256 条校准序列的情况下压缩 Transformer 模型（如 LLaMA-7B），在 60% 压缩率下将 WikiText-2 困惑度从 42.1 降至 11.4。实验表明块级优化起正则化作用，跨架构和压缩率均有提升，但下游任务准确率仍远低于稠密模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单矩阵 SVD 截断在白化 Frobenius 范数下虽为 Eckart-Young 最优，但误差会在非线性前向传播中累积；现有方法缺乏从单矩阵到块再到全模型的层级联合优化，导致压缩后模型性能大幅下降。

Method: 构建三级优化链：L1 对每个矩阵独立进行白化 SVD 截断；L2 在 Transformer 块级别联合优化压缩矩阵，缓解误差累积；L3 使用语言建模损失端到端微调全模型。仅需 256 条校准序列，无需指令或恢复数据。

Result: LLaMA-7B 60% 压缩下，WikiText-2 困惑度从 42.1→19.1→11.4。块级优化作为正则化器：跳过 L2 会使 PTB 困惑度恶化 24 点，额外端到端训练无法弥补。增益在 20%-80% 压缩率、5 种架构（至 13B）、域内外基准上均成立。更多校准数据时跳过 L2 具竞争力，揭示离线算力-数据权衡。下游任务准确率仍远低于稠密模型。

Conclusion: 三级优化链显著提升压缩模型的困惑度和压缩保真度，块级联合优化是关键正则化步骤。但下游任务性能未恢复至稠密模型水平，且跨架构实验配置不统一、压缩率扫描缺乏统一协议，结论仅限于困惑度指标。

Abstract: Per-matrix singular value decomposition (SVD) truncation is Eckart-Young optimal in the whitened Frobenius norm, but errors from independently compressed matrices compound through the block's nonlinear forward pass. Inspired in part by hierarchical variational optimization in quantum many-body methods, we introduce a three-level chain that widens optimization scope from individual matrices to Transformer blocks to the full model: whitened SVD~(L1), block-level joint optimization~(L2), and end-to-end language-modeling loss refinement~(L3), all from 256 calibration sequences, with no instruction or recovery data. On LLaMA-7B at 60% compression, the chain reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 42.1 to 19.1 to 11.4. The block-level stage acts as a regularizer: skipping it worsens Penn Treebank (PTB) perplexity by 24 points, a gap that additional end-to-end training did not close in our experiments. Perplexity gains hold across 20-80% compression, five architectures up to 13B parameters, and both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks, though the cross-architecture rows use architecture-specific configurations and the ratio sweep was not run under one common protocol. With more calibration data, skipping the block-level stage becomes competitive, revealing an offline compute--data trade-off. We therefore claim improvements only in perplexity and compression fidelity; downstream accuracy remains well below the dense model.

</details>


### [463] [Task-Directed Residual AddUNet:Perfect-Reconstruction Routing for Full-Rate Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15857)
*Vikram R. Lakkavalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了AddUNet的完美重构（PR）解释及其满速率实现，提出了残差满速率PR架构用于任务导向表征学习。核心贡献：揭示约束加性U-Net的幸存者-跳连结构等价于临界采样多速率PR滤波器组；满速率公式移除了互补子带限制且保持PR；提出的架构可将任务无关、干扰或冗余结构从任务导向幸存者中路由出去，同时显式保留路由信息；保证任意形状兼容的线性/非线性路由算子的精确重构，无需可逆性、匹配合成滤波器组、重构损失或学习解码器。实验验证了线性可分因子的精确单通道路由，在TIMIT上将测试PER从28.60±2.09%降至25.76±0.41%，且说话人探针实验表明结构守恒不蕴含任务特定不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有U-Net及其变体缺乏理论化的完美重构保证，且临界采样系统存在互补子带限制。需要一种架构：(1)提供结构化的精确重构保证；(2)解耦表征设计与重构设计；(3)支持任务导向的路由学习，显式分离任务相关与无关信息；(4)不依赖可逆性、匹配解码器或重构损失。

Method: 1. 理论分析：证明约束加性U-Net的幸存者-跳连结构等价于临界采样多速率PR滤波器组。2. 满速率推广：移除互补子带限制，保持PR性质。3. 残差满速率PR架构：引入路由算子将任务无关/冗余结构从幸存者分支路由至残差分支，保证任意形状兼容线性/非线性路由算子的精确重构。4. 解耦设计：重构由结构守恒保证，学习专注于任务导向路由。5. 关联ResNet：识别带残差输出保留的恒等捷径ResNet为满速率PR系统。

Result: 1. 理论验证：线性可分因子的精确单通道路由达机器精度。2. TIMIT语音识别：固定识别器与训练协议下，测试PER从28.60±2.09%降至25.76±0.41%，同时保持精确重构。3. 说话人探针：结构守恒本身不导致任务特定不变性，验证了路由学习的必要性。

Conclusion: 本工作为任务导向表征学习提供了具有精确重构保证的理论框架。残差满速率PR架构通过结构化守恒实现表征与重构解耦，学习专注于任务相关路由。实验表明该方法在保持精确可逆性的同时显著提升下游任务性能，且揭示了结构守恒与任务不变性的本质区别。

Abstract: This paper establishes a perfect-reconstruction (PR) interpretation of AddUNet and its full-rate realization, and introduces a Residual Full-Rate PR architecture for task-directed representation learning. The survivor--skip structure of a constrained additive U-Net is shown to be exactly equivalent to a critically sampled multirate PR filter bank. The full-rate formulation removes the complementary-subband restrictions of the critically sampled system while preserving PR. A Residual Full-Rate PR architecture is then proposed to progressively route task-irrelevant, nuisance, or redundant structure away from the task-facing survivor while retaining the routed information explicitly. Exact reconstruction is guaranteed for arbitrary shape-compatible linear or nonlinear routing operators, without requiring invertibility, a matched synthesis bank, reconstruction loss, or learned decoder. The resulting architecture decouples representation design from reconstruction design: conservation is structural, while learning is devoted to task-directed routing. The same formulation identifies an identity-shortcut ResNet with its residual output retained as a full-rate PR system. Experiments verify exact single-channel routing of linearly separable factors to machine precision. On TIMIT, the proposed front-end improves test PER from $28.60\pm2.09\%$ to $25.76\pm0.41\%$ with the recognizer and training protocol held fixed, while maintaining exact reconstruction. Speaker probing further shows that structural conservation does not itself imply task-specific invariance.

</details>


### [464] [LLM-Based Schema-Aware Split Learning for Privacy-Preserving Mental Distress Prediction Across Heterogeneous Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15871)
*Md Khalid Syfullah,Alvi Ataur Khalil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的模式感知分裂学习框架，用于异构心理健康调查数据的隐私保护协作分析。该框架将调查记录序列化为自然语言描述，利用LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct经过LoRA微调后作为共享语义编码器，在客户端与服务端间划分模型，实现了数据不出本地、计算资源高效利用以及跨机构异构模式的语义对齐。在仅2000个训练样本下平均ANLS达0.708，在9种设置中有8种优于联邦学习，客户端计算量降低三个数量级，并能泛化到未见数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会与生活方式复杂性增加导致全球心理困扰患病率上升，教育机构、工作场所、诊所等收集了大量心理健康调查数据。协作分析这些数据可构建泛化性强的预测模型，但隐私限制和调查设计差异（不同问题、量表、格式）阻碍了直接整合。

Method: 提出模式感知分裂学习框架：1）将每条调查记录序列化为自然语言描述，统一异构调查模式为通用格式；2）使用大语言模型（LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct）作为共享语义编码器，通过低秩适应（LoRA）微调用于心理困扰评估；3）将模型在客户端与服务端间分区：客户端保留原始调查响应本地，仅运行轻量级前端，原始记录不出机构；服务端运行资源密集型主干网络，最小化客户端计算开销。

Result: 实验结果：平均ANLS达到0.708（仅用2000训练样本），在9个设置中有8个超越联邦学习基线，客户端计算量降低三个数量级（约1000倍），且模型能泛化到未见数据集。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了准确、隐私保护、资源高效的异构心理健康调查数据协作学习，为跨机构心理健康数据分析提供了可行的技术路径。

Abstract: Rising societal and lifestyle complexity has been linked to a growing prevalence of mental distress worldwide. Educational institutions, workplaces, clinics, etc. collect large volumes of mental health survey data to understand and reduce this burden. Collaborative analysis of such data could yield effective generalizable predictive models. Privacy constraints and varied survey designs (i.e., different questions, scales, and formats) hinder direct integration. We propose a schema-aware split learning (SL) framework that preserves privacy, using a large language model (LLM) as a shared semantic encoder to harmonize heterogeneous survey schemas across institutions. We serialize each survey record into a natural-language description, unifying disparate survey schemas into a common format. The LLM is fine-tuned for mental distress assessment via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and partitioned across client and server. Clients retain the raw survey responses locally and run only a lightweight front-end, so original records never leave the institution that collected them. The resource-intensive backbone runs on the server, minimizing client-side computation. Using LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct, the framework attains an average ANLS of 0.708 with only 2,000 training samples, surpasses federated learning (FL) in eight of nine settings, and cuts per-client computation by three orders of magnitude, while generalizing to unseen datasets. Overall, it enables accurate, privacy-preserving, and resource-efficient collaborative learning from heterogeneous mental health survey data.

</details>


### [465] [Learning Multimodal One-step Flow Policy via Value-weighted Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15883)
*Jaehun Shon,Jinha Choi,Jongwook Jeon,Jongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OptiFlow，一种基于最优传输的一步Flow策略学习框架，解决离线RL中多模态动作分布的高效表示问题，避免模式崩塌和OOD偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线RL依赖固定数据集，数据常包含多模态动作分布。Flow策略虽能自然表示多模态，但学习高效的一步Flow策略面临挑战：标准价值引导易导致模式崩塌或利用分布外区域的高估偏差。需要一种方法能锚定高价值、数据支持的模式，同时避免OOD发散。

Method: OptiFlow将一步Flow策略学习建模为结构化样本分配问题。联合训练价值感知的参考Flow策略和高效一步策略，通过状态级熵正则最优传输耦合其动作样本。评论家估计的价值决定蒸馏目标动作的优先级，动作距离成本保证几何兼容配对。避免直接最大化评论家，实现分布内利用。

Result: 实验表明OptiFlow能有效捕捉最优多模态行为，在多样化的离线RL基准上取得强性能。

Conclusion: OptiFlow通过最优传输引导的一步Flow策略学习，成功解决了离线RL中多模态表示、模式崩塌和OOD偏差的问题，提供了一种几何兼容且价值感知的高效策略学习范式。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn a policy solely from fixed datasets, which often contain multimodal action distributions. Flow policies can naturally represent such multimodal behaviors, but learning an efficient one-step flow policy remains challenging: standard value guidance often leads to mode collapse or exploits overestimation bias in out-of-distribution regions. To address this, we introduce One-step Flow policy via Optimal Transport (OptiFlow), a framework for one-step flow policy learning as a structured sample-allocation problem. OptiFlow jointly trains a value-aware reference flow policy and an efficient one-step policy, coupling their action samples through state-wise entropic optimal transport. For each state, critic-estimated values define the priority of distillation target actions, while the action-distance cost ensures geometrically compatible pairings. By avoiding direct critic maximization, our transport-guided approach enables in-distribution exploitation by anchoring the one-step policy to high-value, dataset-supported modes without the risk of out-of-distribution divergence. Experimental results demonstrate that OptiFlow effectively captures optimal multimodal behaviors and achieves strong performance across diverse offline RL benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yonsei-DILLab/OptiFlow.

</details>


### [466] [Privacy-enhanced federated learning via asynchronous aggregation and local differential perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15885)
*Zhen Zhong,Shini Yang,Liesheng Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种隐私增强的联邦学习框架，融合动态差分隐私、轻量级同态加密和本地差分隐私，采用带版本控制的异步聚合策略，在CIFAR-10和Purchase-100上实现高准确率（82.6%）且通信开销降低21.3%，有效平衡隐私保护与模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决分布式数据环境下的安全协作训练问题，在严格隐私约束下保持模型性能，并支持异步分布式训练环境。

Method: 集成动态差分隐私（DDP）、轻量级同态加密（HE）和本地差分隐私（LDP）机制，采用带版本控制的异步聚合策略进行分布式训练。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和Purchase-100基准数据集上，严格隐私约束（ε=0.1）下达到82.6%分类准确率，通信开销较FedAvg降低21.3%。

Conclusion: 该框架有效平衡隐私保护与模型性能，为大规模分布式协作计算提供可扩展技术基础。

Abstract: This study proposes a privacy-enhanced federated learning framework to address secure collaborative training in distributed data environments. The framework integrates Dynamic Differential Privacy (DDP), lightweight Homomorphic Encryption (HE), and Local Differential Privacy (LDP) mechanisms to ensure data privacy protection during model training. Additionally, the framework employs an asynchronous aggregation strategy with version control to support distributed training in asynchronous environments. Experimental validation on the CIFAR-10 and Purchase-100 benchmark datasets demonstrates that the method maintains high classification accuracy (up to 82.6%) even under stringent privacy constraints (ε = 0.1), while reducing communication overhead by 21.3% compared to FedAvg. Experimental results demonstrate that this framework effectively balances privacy protection and model performance in distributed machine learning scenarios, providing a scalable technical foundation for large-scale distributed collaborative computing.

</details>


### [467] [Discrete Beckmann Transport Models for One-Step Language Modeling and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15903)
*Sophia Tang,Shiyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出离散贝克曼传输模型（DBTM），一种无需教师模型蒸馏、无时间条件的离散流模型，通过自主传输映射在单步内将任意点映射到单纯形顶点的不动点，实现了一步或少步生成，在语言建模和推理任务上超越离散扩散和连续流基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的离散扩散和流模型压缩多步采样为少步通常需要蒸馏预训练教师模型，这限制了学生模型的质量上限，且需要昂贵的两阶段训练流程。作者旨在开发一种直接从数据学习、无需教师模型和时间条件、能在一步或少步内生成高质量样本的离散流模型。

Method: 构建基于时间无关流的离散贝克曼传输模型（DBTM）。其自主传输映射可证明地在单步内将环境空间中任意点搬运到单纯形顶点的不动点。该不动点性质由一个守恒方程刻画，其残差可直接从数据最小化，从而移除对教师流和时间条件的依赖。部分训练的映射对应有限时间的流截断，生成简化为迭代该映射直至达到不动点。进一步将映射扩展为部分上下文插值器，使额外的函数评估作为细化步骤而非 ODE 积分步骤。

Result: 在语言建模和推理任务上，DBTM 实现了一步和少步生成，生成质量和准确率均优于离散扩散和连续流基线模型。

Conclusion: DBTM 通过理论保证的不动点传输映射和直接从数据优化的守恒方程，消除了教师蒸馏和时间条件的需求，提供了一种高效、高质量的离散生成范式，为少步甚至一步离散生成开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion and flow models are a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, but compressing many-step sampling into fewer steps typically requires distilling a pretrained teacher model. This caps the student at the teacher's quality and requires a costly two-stage training pipeline. We introduce Discrete Beckmann Transport Models (DBTM), built on a time-independent flow whose autonomous transport map provably carries any point in the ambient space to a fixed point on the vertices of the simplex in a single step. We show that this fixed-point property is characterized by a conservation equation whose residual can be minimized directly from data, removing the requirement for a teacher flow and time conditioning. Under this construction, a partially trained map corresponds to the flow truncated at finite time, so generation reduces to iterating one map until it reaches a fixed point. We further extend the map to a partial-context interpolant where additional function evaluations act as refinement steps rather than ODE integration steps. On language modeling and reasoning tasks, DBTM enables one- and few-step generation that improves quality and accuracy over discrete diffusion and continuous flow baselines.

</details>


### [468] [Safe Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Information Space Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15915)
*Zeyang Li,Sunbochen Tang,Navid Azizan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个安全元强化学习框架，通过在信息空间中推理安全性，引入安全价值函数并利用其进行安全过滤和约束策略优化，解决了元强化学习在现实任务中的安全性应用难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元强化学习使智能体能以有限经验适应新任务，但安全性要求阻碍了其在现实任务中的应用，且现有工作很少探索安全性问题。

Method: 核心洞察是在信息空间（物理状态+任务信念）中推理安全性，引入安全价值函数衡量智能体无限期避开不安全区域的概率，证明其满足自洽条件和贝尔曼方程从而可通过元强化学习学习，进而开发算法学习该函数并用于安全过滤和约束策略优化。

Result: 在元强化学习基准实验中验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架显式考虑适应过程中的安全性，通过信息空间中的安全价值函数实现可学习的安全保证，为元强化学习在现实安全关键任务中的应用提供了理论基础和实用算法。

Abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to adapt to unseen tasks with limited experience. Despite its promise, the application of meta-RL in real-world tasks is hindered by safety requirements, which have been underexplored in prior work. In this paper, we propose a safe meta-RL framework that explicitly accounts for safety during adaptation. Our key insight is to reason about safety in the information space, which captures both the physical state and the agent's belief over the underlying task. Within this space, we introduce a safety value function that measures the probability of the agent avoiding unsafe regions indefinitely. We show that this function satisfies a self-consistency condition and a Bellman equation, which make it learnable via meta-RL. Based on this formulation, we develop a safe meta-RL algorithm that learns the safety value function and leverages it for safety filtering and constrained policy optimization. Experiments on meta-RL benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [469] [Privacy-Aligned Personalized Federated Learning with Compact Adaptation and Variable-Length Gaussian Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15950)
*Yilin Xu,Chun Hei Michael Shiu,Chih Wei Ling,Linqi Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种记录级差分隐私下的个性化联邦学习框架，通过一次性发布私有客户端上下文并将后续适应限制在固定系数空间中，解决了低维客户端特异性变化与高维模型更新之间的结构错位问题，并利用变长量化实现高斯机制，使量化误差本身成为隐私扰动，在MNIST和CIFAR-10上达到或超越全模型私有适应性能，同时将受保护的上行通信量降低2.67倍（ε=16时）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在记录级差分隐私设置下，个性化联邦学习面临结构错位：客户端特异性变化通常是低维的，但训练过程却反复释放高维模型更新，导致隐私预算浪费和通信开销大。现有方法未充分利用这种低维结构，且额外添加噪声进一步损害模型效用。

Method: 1. 一次性发布私有客户端上下文（因子化生成器），将后续个性化适应限制在固定的低维系数空间中。2. 因子化生成器诱导自适应优化几何，重塑噪声更新；消融实验表明径向演化保留了大部分私有训练增益。3. 通过变长量化直接实现系数更新的高斯机制，量化误差本身作为隐私扰动，无需额外失真，实现有限期望码长。

Result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，该设计在各种隐私预算和客户端异质性下均匹配或优于全模型私有适应基线。在CIFAR-10上ε=16时，受保护的上行通信量减少2.67倍，同时保持可比的未来客户端准确率。

Conclusion: 通过结构性地将个性化适应限制在低维系数空间并利用量化误差作为隐私噪声，本文实现了高效的记录级差分隐私个性化联邦学习，显著降低了通信开销并保持了模型效用，为隐私保护联邦学习提供了新的设计范式。

Abstract: Record-level differential privacy exposes a structural misalignment in personalized federated learning when client-specific variation is low-dimensional while training repeatedly releases high-dimensional updates. In this paper, we address this misalignment by releasing a private client context once and confining repeated adaptation to a fixed coefficient space. Beyond dimensionality reduction, the factorized generator induces an adaptive optimization geometry that reshapes noisy updates, and controlled ablations show that most of its private-training gain is retained by radial evolution. To further reduce the communication cost, we realize the Gaussian mechanism for coefficient updates directly through variable-length quantization with finite expected code length, so that the quantization error itself serves as the required privacy perturbation rather than extra distortion. Across MNIST and CIFAR-10, our design matches or outperforms full-model private adaptation across privacy budgets and client heterogeneity, while reducing protected uplink by a factor of 2.67 at \(\varepsilon=16\) on CIFAR-10 with comparable future-client accuracy.

</details>


### [470] [A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15980)
*Xingyun Wang,Haomin Zheng,Man Yuan,Leqian Yang,Ziming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现视频模型生成物理错误运动并非未学会正确运动，而是学会了但未能使用。正确运动潜藏在模型内部，可通过基于物理变量的低维编辑恢复，称为“因果可写性”。存在尖锐的深度边界：编辑在边界前有效、边界后失效，标志着“承诺”。运动信号仍存留，更强的下游写入可恢复，过强则过冲。早期可写性预测训练后会修正的错误。在1.3B预训练视频模型中复现，具泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视频模型生成物理错误运动的根因：是未学会正确运动，还是学会了但无法调用？

Method: 在红质量慢振荡、蓝质量快振荡的视频上训练，测试红质量快观测运动的冲突情况。利用简单物理变量预测的低维编辑干预模型内部表示，在不同网络深度、不同编辑强度下观察生成运动的变化；并在1.3B预训练视频模型上复现实验。

Result: 1. 因果可写性：冲突情况下模型生成慢运动，但低维编辑能恢复正确的快运动。2. 尖锐深度边界：固定编辑强度下，编辑在边界层前改变视频、边界层后无效，标志承诺。3. 运动信号持久：边界后信号仍存，更强下游写入可恢复物理运动，过强则过冲。4. 早期可写性预测训练修正：训练后被修正的错误，在更多网络深度处可写；持续存在的错误则不可写。5. 1.3B预训练模型中复现上述现象。

Conclusion: 视频模型内部编码了正确的物理运动知识，但因因果可写性随深度关闭而无法部署。因果可写性为理解模型内部知识存取、训练动力学及干预机制提供了新视角，且跨模型规模和训练范式泛化。

Abstract: When a video model generates physically incorrect motion, did it fail to learn the correct motion, or did it learn it but fail to use it? We show the latter: the correct motion remains available inside the model and can still be made to control the generated video. We train on videos where red masses oscillate slowly and blue masses oscillate quickly, then test a red mass with fast observed motion. Even when the model generates slow motion in this conflicting case, a low-dimensional edit predicted from simple physical variables restores the correct fast motion. We call this ability causal writability. At fixed strength, we find a sharp depth boundary: the same edit changes the video before the boundary but not after it. This closure marks commitment for that write. The motion signal nevertheless remains, and a stronger downstream write can restore physical motion, while excessive gain overshoots. Early causal writability predicts which errors training later corrects: those errors are writable at more network depths than errors that persist. We reproduce both causal writability and its sharp closure in a pretrained 1.3B video model, supporting generality across model scale and training regime.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [471] [Self-Indexing Attention for Compression-Compatible Sparse Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13205)
*Xu Yang,Jiapeng Zhang,Zhangke,Changjian Chen,Yuxin Chen,Feiqiang Sun,Chengguang Xu,Feng Jin,Zhuo Tang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出Self-Indexing Attention，一种无需训练的稀疏长上下文推理框架，利用共享的变换域符号-幅度表示实现prefill和decode阶段的统一token检索，通过1-bit索引和位运算实现高效推理，在保持性能接近稠密注意力的同时获得显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏长上下文推理方法在prefill和decode阶段使用不同的检索策略，导致无法复用同一检索表示，增加了存储和计算开销，且难以与外部KV-cache压缩兼容。

Method: Self-Indexing Attention基于共享的变换域符号-幅度表示：关键符号提供可复用的token级索引，用于分组prefill选择和decode检索；同一表示兼容外部KV-cache压缩，无需额外indexer元数据；1-bit索引支持现代加速器广泛支持的位运算实现高效检索。

Result: 在5%注意力密度下，LongBench和RULER基准上性能接近稠密注意力；prefill注意力算子加速高达6.1倍，decode加速高达10.3倍；实验验证了与TurboQuant、DeepSeekV4-Flash等低比特KV-cache压缩和预训练稀疏注意力indexer的兼容性。

Conclusion: Self-Indexing Attention通过统一的变换域表示解决了prefill/decode检索不一致问题，实现了免训练、可复用、硬件友好的稀疏长上下文推理，同时保持与现有压缩技术的兼容性。

Abstract: Sparse long-context inference requires efficient token retrieval in both prefill and decode. Existing methods often use different retrieval strategies for the two stages, preventing one retrieval representation from being reused throughout inference. We propose Self-Indexing Attention, a training-free framework built on a shared transform-domain sign-magnitude representation. The key signs provide a reusable token-level index for grouped prefill selection and decode retrieval, while the same representation remains compatible with external KV-cache compression without separate indexer metadata. This 1-bit index enables efficient retrieval through bitwise operations widely supported by modern accelerators. At 5% attention density, Self-Indexing Attention remains close to dense attention on LongBench and RULER and achieves up to 6.1x prefill and 10.3x decode attention-operator speedups. Experiments with TurboQuant and DeepSeekV4-Flash further demonstrate compatibility with low-bit KV-cache compression and pretrained sparse-attention indexers.

</details>


### [472] [Decoupling Error Attribution in Cloud-Native Graph-RAG: A Data Integrity Diagnostic Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13324)
*Shuai Yan,Yuhang Wu,Xiaodong Huang,Ke Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出三层解耦诊断框架，量化分析云原生数据库中Graph-RAG系统的错误归因，发现数据完整性而非算法推理是性能瓶颈，并揭示参数知识掩盖效应（PKME）会掩盖存储退化导致监控失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Graph-RAG系统假设数据质量完美，忽略云原生数据库扰动对系统的严重影响，缺乏正交归因错误来源的诊断方法。

Method: 构建三层解耦诊断框架，正交归因推理损失、知识图谱缺陷、Cypher生成错误；在西藏东南部时空生态知识图谱上引入八类缺陷进行实验评估。

Result: 结构性缺陷导致系统准确率从0.93跌至0.39，数据完整性为主导瓶颈；发现PKME使LLM利用内部记忆补偿断裂检索路径，使查询生成表观错误降低70%以上，掩盖存储恶化并增加自动监控假阴性风险。

Conclusion: 为云基础信息融合系统的数据完整性审计与优化提供定量基础，强调需显式监控存储层退化而非仅依赖端到端指标。

Abstract: Graph-RAG systems often assume pristine data quality, overlooking the severe impact of perturbations in cloud-native databases. This paper proposes a three-layer decoupled diagnostic framework to orthogonally attribute system errors to reasoning loss, Knowledge Graph (KG) defects, and Cypher generation errors. Evaluated on a spatio-temporal ecological KG of the Southeastern Tibet region with eight defect types, results reveal that data integrity, rather than algorithmic reasoning, is the dominant performance bottleneck, with structural defects degrading system accuracy from 0.93 to 0.39. Crucially, we observe a masking-like phenomenon termed the Parametric Knowledge Masking Effect (PKME), suggesting LLMs compensate for broken retrieval paths using internal memory. This shrinks apparent query generation errors by over 70 percent, obscuring actual storage deterioration and increasing the risk of false negatives for automated monitoring. This work provides a quantitative foundation for auditing and optimizing data integrity in cloud-based information fusion systems.

</details>


### [473] [PCGNet: Unifying Shared and Specific Information for Fashion Matching Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13339)
*Shuiying Liao,P. Y. Mok*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PCGNet 是一个多目标图学习框架，通过对比互信息最大化、相关感知邻居采样和可学习全局图增强，统一建模商品兼容性与用户个性化偏好，在时尚搭配推荐任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时尚推荐模型过度简化商品兼容性与用户个性化偏好之间的关系，忽视二者的复杂交互；且现有数据驱动方法未针对稀疏、噪声大的真实时尚数据进行优化。

Method: 提出 PCGNet，采用对比互信息最大化提取并对齐共享与视图特有模式，捕捉兼容性与偏好的复杂交互；引入相关感知邻居采样和可学习全局图增强，从图中挖掘自监督信号增强表示；联合优化 BPR 排序损失与多视角互信息损失生成推荐分数。

Result: 在两个基准数据集上，PCGNet 在全部四个评估指标上显著优于最先进方法。

Conclusion: PCGNet 通过统一建模商品兼容性与个性化偏好，并利用图自监督增强表示学习，有效解决了时尚搭配推荐中的稀疏性与噪声问题，达到最先进性能。

Abstract: In fashion domain, recommending complementary clothing items that match selected pieces is a crucial cross-selling technique that improves customer satisfaction. Nevertheless, fashion matching presents significant challenges, as recommendations must not only align with individual user fashion preferences but also ensure compatibility between garments. These challenges are twofold. First, existing models often assume an overly simplified decoupled relationship between product compatibility and personalized user preferences, overlooking the natural complexity between the two. Second, existing data-driven approaches are not optimized for real-world fashion data, which is typically sparse and characterized by noisy interactions. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Compatibility Graph Network, a multi-objective graph learning framework that organically unifies the modeling of product compatibility and personal preferences. PCGNet uses contrastive mutual information maximization to extract and align shared and view-specific patterns, thereby capturing the complex interplay between compatibility and personal preferences. Moreover, we introduce a correlation-aware neighbor sampling and a learnable global graph augmentation, which enhance the model by incorporating self-supervised signals mined directly from the graph, ensuring more stable and informative representations. Finally, PCGNet generates recommendation scores through the joint optimization of BPR ranking loss and multi-view mutual information losses. Experimental validation on two benchmark datasets demonstrates that PCGNet significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods across all four evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [474] [Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Can Be Strong and Efficient Retrievers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13486)
*Anubhav Shrestha,Safal Shrestha,Minwu Kim,Torsten Suel,Keith Ross*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 大语言模型作为首阶段检索器的效果，发现 MoE 检索器在相似激活参数量下优于稠密模型，且能在不重新训练的情况下减少专家数量以大幅降低查询编码时间，同时保持检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作表明微调纯解码器大语言模型可构建强效首阶段检索器，但模型规模增大导致编码成本随之增加。MoE 模型通过每个 token 仅激活部分参数来实现高效扩展，广泛用于生成任务，但在检索任务中尚未被充分探索。

Method: 作者从多个模型家族中训练 MoE 和稠密 LLMs，采用相同训练流程，在多样化数据集上评估，并在相同服务配置下测量查询编码时间。进一步实验在不重新训练和重建索引的前提下，减少查询编码时使用的专家数量。

Result: MoE 检索器在 BEIR 上比同等激活参数量的稠密检索器高出最多 3.0 nDCG@10。最强 MoE 检索器以 59% 更少的激活参数和 18% 更低的查询编码时间匹配 8B 稠密检索器。减少专家数量可保留 99% 以上检索效果，同时查询编码时间最多降低 26%。强 MoE 首阶段检索器往往匹配或超越重排后的配置。

Conclusion: MoE 大语言模型可以成为强效且高效的首阶段检索器，在保持高检索质量的同时显著降低计算成本，且无需重新训练即可进一步加速推理。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that fine-tuning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) for retrieval yields strong first-stage retrievers, with effectiveness improving as backbones grow in size. However, every query and document must pass through the full model, so encoding cost increases with model size. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs activate only a subset of parameters per token and are widely used to scale generative models, yet remain underexplored as retrievers. We systematically study MoE backbones for retrieval by training MoE and dense LLMs from several families using the same procedure, evaluating them across diverse datasets, and measuring query encoding time under the same serving configuration. We show that MoE retrievers outperform dense retrievers with comparable active parameter counts by up to 3.0 nDCG@10 points on BEIR. One of our strongest MoE retrievers matches an 8B dense retriever with 59% fewer active parameters and 18% lower query encoding time. We further show that the number of experts used for query encoding can be reduced without retraining or re-indexing, retaining more than 99% of retrieval effectiveness while reducing query encoding time by up to 26%. Recent rerankers provide only modest additional gains over strong MoE first stages, which often match or exceed the reranked configurations we evaluate. Together, these results show that MoE LLMs can be strong and efficient first-stage retrievers.

</details>


### [475] [Pre-retrieval Query Clustering for Adaptive Top-k Document Retrieval in RAG Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13489)
*Ye Xia,Emre Yamangil,Haixun Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种查询自适应检索深度框架，通过离线聚类查询并为每个聚类确定最佳 top-k，解决了固定 top-k 检索在简单查询过度检索和复杂查询检索不足的问题，在全流量测试中 F1 提升 36% 且低复杂度查询 token 使用量降低 14%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统采用固定 top-k 检索策略，导致简单查询引入噪声和成本（过度检索），复杂查询因召回不足导致答案错误（检索不足）。核心动机是探究：要可靠回答任意查询，究竟需要检索多少文档？

Method: 离线阶段：在默认检索器下测量每个查询的 NDCG，从 NDCG-k 曲线推导查询特定的饱和点 k*；在嵌入空间聚类大量查询，用均值加方差规则为每个聚类生成目标覆盖率约 95% 的推荐检索深度。在线阶段：将新查询分配到最近聚类，直接使用该聚类的 top-k，实现常数时间决策。该方法属于预检索、以查询为中心，区别于基于检索后文档聚类的置信度方法。

Result: 在法律、医疗、金融、企业搜索等异构语料上验证：全流量查询 F1 提升超 36%，低复杂度聚类 token 使用量降低 14% 且无准确率损失。相比后检索置信度方法，本框架在异构、案例型语料中更鲁棒，且跨领域适用。

Conclusion: 提出的查询自适应检索深度框架实用且通用，通过离线聚类与饱和点估计，在线常数时间选择 top-k，有效平衡召回与成本，显著提升 RAG 系统性能与效率。

Abstract: RAG systems commonly retrieve a fixed number of documents (top-k) to ground generation, but this static approach is brittle: simple queries suffer over-retrieval (adding noise and cost) while complex queries are under-retrieved, causing recall failures that cascade into incorrect answers. Motivated by the question of how many documents must be retrieved to answer an arbitrary query reliably, we propose a practical, general framework for query-adaptive retrieval depth. Offline, we estimate per-query retrieval difficulty by measuring NDCG under the default retriever and deriving a query-specific saturation point k* from the NDCG-k curve. Because computing these signals online is expensive, we cluster a large set of queries in embedding space and summarize each cluster with a recommended retrieval depth that targets high coverage (e.g., ~95%) using a mean-plus-variance rule. At runtime, the system assigns an incoming query to a cluster and selects the corresponding top-k in constant time. Compared with post-retrieval confidence methods that rely on clustering retrieved documents, our approach is pre-retrieval and query-centric, making it robust in heterogeneous, case-like corpora and applicable across domains such as legal, healthcare, finance, and enterprise search. Finally, this framework has been tested in full-traffic queries that improved $F_1$ by over 36% while reducing token usage by 14% on low-complexity clusters without accuracy loss.

</details>


### [476] [Addressing Cross-Stage Decoupling of Semantic and Collaborative Signals in Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13678)
*Jiayi Dan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出SCRec框架，解决生成式推荐系统中两阶段流水线（语义分词与生成阶段）的信息解耦问题，通过协作增强分词、语义引导生成和流形对齐三个组件，实现语义与协作信号的跨阶段对齐，提升推荐精度且额外开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐系统通常采用两阶段流水线：第一阶段基于文本语义进行项目分词，忽略协作信号和交互相似性；第二阶段基于交互数据重新嵌入码本序列，忽视原始语义信息。这种跨阶段信息解耦导致语义连贯性缺失，限制了推荐准确性。

Method: 提出SCRec通用框架，包含三个相互关联的组件：(1) 协作增强分词：将文本化协作信号显式注入语义分词过程，无需额外对齐任务；(2) 语义引导生成：在生成阶段利用可学习码本嵌入动态重校准语义先验；(3) 流形对齐：协调离散码本索引嵌入空间与稠密连续语义空间的几何错配。

Result: 大量实验验证了SCRec框架的有效性、鲁棒性和泛化能力，在最小额外训练和推理开销下显著提升了跨阶段信息连贯性和推荐精度。

Conclusion: SCRec通过双向信息补充实现跨阶段连贯性增强，成功对齐语义与协作信号，为生成式推荐提供了一个通用且高效的解决方案，具有广泛的适用性和扩展潜力。

Abstract: Generative recommendation reformulates sequential recommendation as autoregressive generation by encoding items into semantic tokens, enabling improved scaling capability and cross-domain generalization. However, existing generative recommender systems typically follow a two-stage pipeline, where item tokenization is largely dominated by textual semantics with limited incorporation of collaborative signals and interaction similarity, leading to code assignments that are misaligned with downstream generation. Conversely, the generation stage tends to overlook the original semantic information, as the code sequences are re-embedded based on interaction data. This cross-stage information decoupling limits semantic coherence and recommendation accuracy.
  To address this issue, we propose SCRec, a general framework that enhances cross-stage coherence through bidirectional information supplementation. Specifically, we introduce (i) collaborative-enhanced tokenization to explicitly inject textualized collaborative signals into semantic tokenization, without introducing additional alignment task, (ii) semantic-guided generation to dynamically recalibrate semantic priors with learnable code embeddings in generation stage, and (iii) manifold alignment to reconcile the geometric mismatch between the embedding space of discrete codebook indices and the dense continuous semantic space. These interrelated components form a general framework that aligns semantic and collaborative signals and enhances cross-stage information coherence, with minimal additional training and inference costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, robustness, and generalizability of our proposed framework.

</details>


### [477] [Odds-Shift Slippage in One-vs-Rest Rankers: Diagnosing and Repairing Reweighting-Induced Top-K Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13810)
*Akifumi Goto*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文研究了One-vs-Rest排序器中使用类别权重（scale_pos_weight）处理标签不平衡时产生的odds-shift slippage（赔率偏移滑移）现象，证明了提升树模型中叶子步长上限对偏移实现程度的理论限制，并提出基于各标签等渗回归的修复方法，在多个基准上有效恢复了MAP@K性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在极度不平衡的多标签排序任务中，常用scale_pos_weight = n_-/n_+来平衡正负样本。根据Elkan's identity，该权重会将标签j的log-odds偏移ln w_j，导致模型按加权odds而非边际概率排序，破坏了precision@K的Bayes最优性。理论建议事后反转偏移，但实际有限样本下、权重达数千时，学习器能实现多少偏移、何种修复有效，此前未被量化测量。

Method: 1. 定义odds-shift slippage为理论承诺偏移与实际实现偏移的差距。2. 在Santander和Instacart数据集上，构建仅权重不同的LightGBM和MLP匹配对进行实证测量。3. 理论证明：叶子步长上限为c的提升树在T轮、学习率η下至多实现Tηc nat的偏移，并通过cap sweep实验验证。4. 分析无上限时饱和单元固定在1.0，超出可分映射范围。5. 提出各标签等渗回归修复，并处理无校准正样本标签映射为先验而非直通。6. 在11个MULAN基准、5种学习器上大规模评估，并引入交叉验证规则缓解稀疏正样本下的校准伤害。

Result: 在Santander上权重使MAP@7从0.808跌至0.117；Boosting模型中理想odds偏移仅占损失的23%（Instacart 32%，MLP 98%），其余为slippage。理论上限得到cap sweep确认。各标签等渗回归将Santander模型恢复至0.784（验证期拟合校准器为0.780），前提是无校准正样本标签映射到先验。在55个基准-学习器组合中，8个组合权重模型损失超一半MAP@K；delicious和Corel5k上修复恢复至无权重水平。交叉验证规则消除了稀疏正样本下的校准伤害。

Conclusion: 类别权重在提升树中因叶子步长上限导致严重slippage，事后解析反转仅在偏移实现且未饱和处有效。各标签等渗回归配合先验映射策略是通用有效的修复，配合交叉验证选择可避免小样本伤害。作者发布oddslip工具包落地该方案。

Abstract: One-vs-rest rankers that show each user the top-$K$ of many rare labels usually counter imbalance with a per-label positive-class weight, scale_pos_weight $= n_-/n_+$. Elkan's identity says such a weight shifts label $j$'s log-odds by $\ln w_j$, so the model ranks by weighted odds rather than by the marginal that is Bayes-optimal for precision@$K$, and suggests inverting the shift afterwards; what a finite learner does with a weight in the thousands, and which repair then works, has not been measured. We call the gap between the promised and the realized shift odds-shift slippage and measure it on matched pairs of LightGBM and MLP models that differ only in the weights. On Santander the weight takes MAP@7 from 0.808 to 0.117; for the boosted pairs the ideal odds shift accounts for 23% of that loss (32% on Instacart; 98% for an MLP pair on the same rows) and slippage for the rest. We prove that a booster whose leaf steps are capped at $c$ realizes at most $Tηc$ nat of shift in $T$ rounds at rate $η$, which a cap sweep confirms, and show that without a cap saturated cells tie at exactly 1.0, beyond the reach of any separable map. The analytic inversion therefore pays only where the shift was realized and nothing saturated, whereas per-label isotonic regression returns the Santander model to 0.784 (0.780 with the calibrator fitted on the validation period), but only if labels without calibration positives are mapped to their prior rather than passed through. On 11 public MULAN benchmarks and 5 learners the weighted model loses more than half of its MAP@$K$ in 8 of 55 cells, and on delicious and Corel5k the same repair returns it to the unweighted level; per-label calibration hurts where positives are scarce, a harm that a cross-validated rule removes. The recipe is released as oddslip.

</details>


### [478] [P3Rec: Distilling Prior--Posterior Preference Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13993)
*Jinfei Chen,Weihai Lu,Jiawei Cheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 P^3Rec 框架，联合提取并内化先验和后验偏好推理知识，通过先验偏好吸收和后验引导偏好蒸馏，结合兴趣熵自适应校准用户表示，实现更完整的偏好推理同时保持推荐效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM-as-Enhancer 方法通常仅从单一视角构建蒸馏知识：先验偏好捕捉用户稳定兴趣但对当前决策指导有限，后验偏好揭示目标相关细粒度兴趣但可能过度依赖目标线索。需要一种方法联合利用两者互补优势。

Method: P^3Rec 首先从用户侧推导目标无关的先验偏好和目标条件的后验偏好，同时从物品语义和前驱交互中提取以物品为中心的偏好表示。然后通过先验偏好吸收和后验引导偏好蒸馏渐进地将先验和后验知识内化到行为表示中。进一步利用兴趣熵刻画历史兴趣分散度，自适应校准用户表示，最后进行对比检索优化。

Result: 在多个公开数据集上的大量实验证明了 P^3Rec 的有效性，优于现有方法。

Conclusion: P^3Rec 通过联合先验和后验偏好推理知识，结合兴趣熵自适应校准，实现了更完整的偏好推理并保持了高效推荐，为 LLM 增强推荐系统提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding and preference reasoning capabilities, offering new opportunities for user modeling in recommender systems. Existing LLM-as-Enhancer methods typically distill LLM-derived preference knowledge into lightweight recommenders to avoid costly online LLM inference. However, they often construct distillation knowledge from only one perspective. Prior preference captures users' stable and consistent interests but provides limited guidance for the current decision, whereas posterior preference reveals target-relevant fine-grained interests but may rely excessively on target clues. To address these limitations, we propose P$^3$Rec, a framework that jointly extracts and internalizes complementary prior and posterior preference reasoning knowledge. Specifically, P$^3$Rec first derives target-agnostic prior preferences and target-conditioned posterior preferences from the user side, while further extracting item-centric preference representations from item semantics and predecessor interactions. It then progressively internalizes prior and posterior knowledge into behavioral representations through prior preference absorption and posterior-guided preference distillation. Since the resulting comprehensive preference representation may not always provide an equally decisive retrieval direction, P$^3$Rec further characterizes historical interest dispersion with interest entropy and adaptively calibrates the user representation before contrastive retrieval optimization. In this way, P$^3$Rec achieves more complete preference reasoning while preserving efficient recommendation. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [479] [TF-IDF and BM25 Are Exact KL Divergences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14016)
*Ivan Silajev*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文将TF-IDF和BM25统一建模为Kullback-Leibler散度，提供了它们的概率理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TF-IDF和BM25是信息检索中最常用的相关性评分方法，但缺乏统一的概率理论推导，无法在理论上与其他方法比较。

Method: 将TF-IDF和BM25（包括实际使用的+1 IDF修正版本和原始版本）表示为两个概率模型之间的Kullback-Leibler散度，建立统一的理论框架。

Result: 两种评分方法均可精确解释为KL散度，框架阐明了它们度量的本质，使其能与其他检索方法进行理论比较。

Conclusion: 该工作为TF-IDF和BM25提供了共同的理论基础，统一了它们的解释，并推动了信息检索评分方法的理论分析。

Abstract: TF-IDF and BM25 are two of the most widely used methods for scoring query-document relevance, yet neither has a standard probabilistic derivation that justifies it as a statistical method within a unified framework. We address this gap by showing that both scoring methods admit an exact interpretation as Kullback-Leibler divergences between two probability models. We treat the BM25 variant that includes the plus 1 correction in the IDF term, which is the one used in practice, and also discuss the original BM25 formulation without that correction. The resulting framework provides a common theoretical basis for TF-IDF and BM25, clarifies what they measure, and allows them to be compared theoretically with other information retrieval methods rather than only experimentally.

</details>


### [480] [VARG: Value-Aware and Ranking-Aligned Generative Retrieval for Dynamic E-commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14493)
*Xiaopeng Chu,Jianbo Zhu,Mingmin Jin,Jing Wang,Xing Fang,Wenyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: VARG 是淘宝搜索中的生成式检索系统，通过 RQ-VAE 构建语义前缀、三阶段监督微调和 Prefix-GRPO 强化学习，直接生成商品候选进入最终排序器，线上 A/B 实验显著提升 GMV、IPV 和 PCTR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商搜索中召回与预排序的融合要求候选生成同时兼顾相关性、个性化和商业价值，现有方法难以在生成式检索中统一建模这些目标并直接接入最终排序器。

Method: 1. VARG-ID：用 RQ-VAE 构建语义前缀，双向查询-商品对比学习增强相关性，引入价值有序第三标记提供细粒度商品地址与商业价值先验。2. 三阶段 SFT：依次学习商品-标识符映射、查询语义检索、个性化检索；引入价值感知与层级对齐监督、扩展用户上下文、局部序数监督（LO-SFT）学习簇内排序。3. Prefix-GRPO：基于输出合法性、用户行为、排序器优势、搜索相关性的门控奖励，结合前缀感知 Token 加权，对齐候选生成与商业价值及排序目标。4. 协同每日产品与模型更新：保留旧商品地址、融入新品与行为反馈。

Result: 离线实验验证标识符稳定性，SFT 与 Prefix-GRPO 显著提升检索质量与头部价值召回。14 天线上 A/B 测试覆盖 20% 流量，GMV +1.45%、人均 IPV +0.22%、PCTR +0.31%；购物向导查询评测显示更小候选配额下仍保持竞争力相关性。

Conclusion: VARG 通过生成式检索统一建模相关性、个性化与商业价值，实现候选直接进入最终排序器，在大规模电商搜索场景取得显著业务指标提升，证明了生成式检索在工业级搜索系统中的可行性与优势。

Abstract: Integrating recall and pre-ranking in e-commerce search requires candidate generation to account for relevance, personalization, and business value before final ranking. To this end, we present VARG, a generative retrieval system for Tmall App search that directly admits generated item candidates to the existing final ranker. VARG-ID constructs semantic prefixes using RQ-VAE, enhances search relevance through bidirectional query-item contrastive learning, and combines these prefixes with a value-ordered third token to provide fine-grained item addresses and a business-value prior. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning progressively learns item-to-identifier mappings, query-semantic retrieval, and personalized retrieval. Personalized model training combines value-aware and hierarchy-aligned supervision with expanded user context, and uses local ordinal supervision (LO-SFT) to learn the local within-cluster ordering encoded by the third token. Prefix-GRPO combines gated rewards based on output legality, user behavior, ranker advantage, and search relevance with prefix-aware token weighting to align candidate generation with business value and ranking objectives. Coordinated daily product and model updates preserve existing item addresses while incorporating new products and behavioral feedback. Offline experiments on tens of millions of products validate identifier stability and demonstrate gains in retrieval quality and head-level value recall from SFT strategies and Prefix-GRPO over their respective baselines. In a 14-day online A/B test covering 20% of search traffic, VARG directly admits generated candidates to the final ranker and improves GMV by 1.45%, per-user IPV by 0.22%, and PCTR by 0.31%. Online shopping-guide query evaluations further show that VARG maintains competitive relevance with a smaller candidate quota.

</details>


### [481] [The Wisdom of the Loudest: A Large-Scale Audit of Generative Search on Reddit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14575)
*Agam Goyal,Wang Claire,Eshwar Chandrasekharan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模审计 Reddit Answers，揭示了生成式搜索在社区问答场景中存在显著的声音选择偏差：检索阶段导致结果不稳定，合成阶段偏好正式、指令性语言，而削弱了第一人称经验性表达，表明生成式搜索并非中立摘要，需在溯源性、多元性和可读性上进行设计优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线社区因其经验与视角的多样性而受重视，但生成式搜索日益成为访问这些话语的中介。目前鲜有研究系统考察哪些社区声音能在检索与合成中幸存，因此需要实证审计以揭示生成式搜索对社区话语的过滤与重塑机制。

Method: 选取 20 个建议与支持类 Reddit 社区，构建 10,000 条查询并重复三轮，共生成 30,000 个回答，覆盖 1468 万条评论。通过对比多轮运行差异、跨社区证据组合模式、评论层级选择倾向，以及语言风格（正式/指令性 vs. 经验性/第一人称单数）在检索与合成各阶段的存活率，量化分析生成式搜索管道中的选择偏差。

Result: 1) 不同运行间的差异主要源于检索阶段；2) 回答常融合多个社区的证据；3) 选择机制强烈偏好已可见的顶层评论；4) 正式和指令性语言更易被检出，而经验性声音在选择阶段存活率低，合成阶段进一步被削弱，第一人称单数用语显著下降。

Conclusion: 社区落地的生成式搜索并非中立摘要，其管道会系统性地过滤掉经验性、主观性声音。未来设计除关注相关性与流畅度外，还需显式优化溯源性、多元性与可读性，以保障社区话语的完整呈现。

Abstract: Online communities are valued not only for answers, but for the diversity of experiences and perspectives they contain. Generative search increasingly mediates access to this discourse, yet little is known about which community voices survive retrieval and synthesis. We audit Reddit Answers using 10,000 queries from 20 advice- and support-seeking communities, repeated three times to produce 30,000 answers over 14.68M comments. We find that differences across runs are driven primarily by retrieval, answers routinely combine evidence across communities, and selection strongly favors already-visible, top-level comments. Formal and directive language is more likely to be surfaced, while experiential voice is less likely to survive selection and is further weakened during synthesis, with first-person singular language declining sharply. These findings show that community-grounded generative search is not neutral summarization, and should be designed not only for relevance and fluency, but also for provenance, plurality, and legibility.

</details>


### [482] [Beyond Benchmark Scores: How Synthetic and Authentic Query Distributions Diverge in RAG Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14579)
*Filip J. Kucia,Barbara M. Gawlik*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文对比了合成查询与真实用户查询在 RAG 系统评估中的差异，发现合成查询更长、覆盖更广，而真实查询更短、集中于少数主题且包含合成未覆盖内容。在高校教务系统实验中，针对合成查询优化的配置在真实查询上性能大幅下降，且选择了高延迟的混合检索器。建议将合成与真实查询视为查询质量谱系的两极：合成验证理想条件下的最大检索能力，真实测试系统对模糊、欠规范输入的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAG 评估主要依赖合成问题集，但这可能掩盖分布偏移下的性能下降，高估部署就绪度。真实用户查询短、集中、且包含合成生成器未覆盖的主题，导致合成基准无法反映真实部署场景。

Method: 在高校教师信息系统上，使用 Gemini Notebook 生成 1,851 条合成问题，收集 322 条学生真实查询。对比查询长度、来源多样性、检索配置性能及延迟，分析合成与真实查询分布差异对检索器选择的影响。

Result: 真实查询平均 6.8 词，来源 53 个；合成查询平均 15.7 词，来源 165 个。在合成基准上表现优异的配置在真实查询上性能显著下降。基于合成查询优化选出的混合检索器延迟高达最快配置的 8 倍，稀疏检索组件仅有利于长合成查询，对短真实查询无益。

Conclusion: 合成与真实查询集应作为互补极端：合成数据验证理想条件下的最大检索容量，真实查询测试系统对不精确、欠规范输入的鲁棒性。评估应结合两者，避免单一合成基准误导部署决策。

Abstract: RAG systems are routinely evaluated using synthetic question sets generated from the target document corpus. While this practice provides a useful check on overall retrieval capability, relying exclusively on synthetic benchmarks can mislead under distribution shift and overstate deployment readiness. Synthetic generation spreads questions evenly across the corpus, formulating long, detailed queries; real users put most of their traffic on a few administrative and procedural topics in short queries, while also asking about matters the generator never covers at all. We demonstrate this gap on a university faculty information system, comparing 1,851 synthetic questions generated via Gemini Notebook against 322 authentic queries collected via a student survey. The synthetic and authentic query sets differ significantly: authentic queries average 6.8 words versus 15.7 for the synthetic ones, and draw from only 53 unique sources compared to 165. Consequently, configurations that appear highly effective on synthetic benchmarks experience a substantial performance drop on authentic queries. Importantly, optimizing on synthetic queries selected a higher-latency hybrid retriever. In our setting the sparse retrieval component benefited long synthetic questions but not short authentic ones, costing up to $8\times$ the latency of the fastest configuration we tested. We propose treating synthetic and authentic query sets as complementary extremes of the query-quality spectrum: synthetic data verifies maximum retrieval capacity under idealized conditions, while authentic queries test system robustness to the imprecise, underspecified inputs of real users.

</details>


### [483] [EviQE: Evidence Selection for LLM-Based Query Expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14875)
*Hai Son Le,Amin Bigdeli,Shirin Seyedsalehi,Morteza Zihayat,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出 EviQE 方法，通过聚合多个重述器检索的文档、选择紧凑证据集并进行单次基于证据的查询扩展，分离了证据选择与生成，实验表明该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法，且额外的检索生成轮次收益有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的查询扩展方法多关注如何生成扩展词，而忽视了模型应读取哪些文档。重述器检索的文档往往互补，单一证据源覆盖率不足，需要一种方法有效聚合并选择高质量证据。

Method: 提出 EviQE：1) 使用多个重述器检索文档并聚合候选集；2) 采用基于相关性的证据选择（LLM-Score）挑选紧凑证据集；3) 仅进行一次基于选定证据的 grounded expansion，避免多轮检索生成。

Result: 在三个 TREC DL 和五个 BEIR 基准上，重述器检索的相关文档各异，聚合候选集覆盖率更高；LLM-Score 证据选择持续优于直接重述、冷启动扩展和单源种子扩展；额外检索生成轮次在强证据已选后收益微小甚至降低效果。

Conclusion: 将证据选择与生成分离，并将重述器视为互补检索视角，单次高质量证据条件扩展即可达到最佳效果，多轮迭代并非必要。

Abstract: LLM-based query expansion increasingly conditions reformulation on documents retrieved from the target corpus, yet most work focuses on how to generate expansions rather than which documents the model should read. We propose EviQE, which aggregates documents retrieved by multiple reformulators, selects a compact evidence set, and uses it for one grounded expansion step. This separates evidence selection from generation and treats reformulators as complementary retrieval perspectives. Across three TREC DL and five BEIR benchmarks, reformulators frequently retrieve distinct relevant documents, so pooled candidates provide higher relevant-document coverage than any individual source. The strongest gains come from relevance-based evidence selection: LLM-Score consistently outperforms direct reformulation, cold-start expansion, and single-source seeded expansion. Additional retrieval-generation rounds provide little benefit once strong conditioning evidence has been selected and can reduce effectiveness.

</details>


### [484] [Route Me If You Can: A Benchmark for Query Reformulation Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14885)
*Hai Son Le,Negar Arabzadeh,Amin Bigdeli,Radin Hamidi Rad,Sajad Ebrahimi,Charles L. A. Clarke,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: QueryRoute 提出了一个统一的查询重写选择基准，冻结了查询、变体、检索结果和 oracle 标签，评估多种选择器，发现存在显著的 oracle 空间但当前选择器仅部分恢复，且选择器排名随检索器变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究难以比较，因为使用不同的重写池、检索器、相关性信号、训练标签和评估指标。需要一个可复现的基准来研究推理时的查询重写选择问题：给定原始查询和候选重写池，应选择哪一个发送给检索器。

Method: 构建 QueryRoute 基准，包含 3,757 个查询、11 个候选系统、5 个重写模型主干、3 个检索器，跨 TREC DL、BEIR、BRIGHT 数据集，共 619,905 个检索结果。冻结原始查询、生成变体、多检索器下的排序列表、检索分数和每查询 oracle 标签。评估监督分类、路由、QPP 和 LLM-as-judge 选择器。

Result: 结果显示相对于固定重写器存在显著的 oracle 空间，但当前选择器仅恢复了部分；选择器排名随检索器变化；相似的平均有效性可能掩盖不同的查询级行为。

Conclusion: 发布的工件和评估工具允许未来选择器在不重新生成变体、重新运行检索或重建判断管道的情况下进行比较。

Abstract: LLM-based query reformulation can improve retrieval, but no single reformulation strategy is consistently optimal across queries, domains, retrievers, or model backbones. This creates an inference-time decision problem: ``Given an original query and a pool of candidate reformulations, which one should be issued to the retriever?''. Existing studies are hard to compare because they use different reformulator pools, retrievers, relevance signals, training labels, and evaluation metrics. We introduce QueryRoute, a benchmark that freezes the expensive artifacts needed to study this decision reproducibly: original queries, generated variants, ranked lists under multiple retrievers, retrieval scores, and per-query oracle labels. The benchmark contains 3,757 queries, 11 candidate systems, five reformulator backbones, and three retrievers across TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT, yielding 619,905 retrieval outcomes. We benchmark supervised classification, routing, QPP, and LLM-as-judge selectors. Results show substantial oracle headroom over fixed reformulators, but current selectors recover only part of it; selector rankings change across retrievers, and similar mean effectiveness can hide different query-level behavior. The released artifacts and evaluation harness allow future selectors to be compared without regenerating variants, rerunning retrieval, or rebuilding judge pipelines. Code and data are available at https://github.com/haisonle001/QueryRoute

</details>


### [485] [LazFormer: Scaling Transformers for Industrial Recommendation via Transferable Generative Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14978)
*Xiaodong Li,Alin Fan,Mingyang Li,Yan Xiao,Shichao Nie,Junfeng Zhang,Shaochuan Lin,Zhanming Ou,Tao Luo,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 LazFormer，一种面向工业推荐的可扩展 Transformer，通过生成式预训练、可迁移残差适配器、请求感知排序模块和非对称多轮训练策略，解决预训练与排序特征不一致导致的负迁移、稀疏参数过拟合及长序列建模效率问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业推荐 Transformer 依赖单一排序模型从头优化稠密和稀疏参数，计算开销大、收敛慢；预训练虽能提供良好初始化，但面临两大局限：(1) 预训练与排序输入特征不一致导致稠密参数负迁移；(2) 排序阶段多轮训练使稀疏参数过拟合，冻结又限制适应性。

Method: 1. 生成式预训练模块：自回归生成序列特征，为稠密和稀疏参数提供良好初始化。2. 可迁移残差适配器：以残差方式注入排序专用特征，缓解稠密参数负迁移。3. 请求感知排序模块：融合长序列压缩、混合稀疏注意力和请求感知范式，高效建模用户长序列。4. 非对称多轮训练策略：跨轮重置稀疏参数同时持续累积稠密参数，缓解稀疏参数过拟合。

Result: 论文未在摘要中给出具体实验指标，但声称 LazFormer 能有效解决负迁移、过拟合和长序列建模效率问题，提升工业推荐中 Transformer 的可扩展性和性能。

Conclusion: LazFormer 通过生成式预训练、残差适配器、请求感知排序模块和非对称多轮训练，系统性解决了工业推荐中 Transformer 预训练迁移的关键难题，为大规模推荐系统提供了可落地的可扩展架构。

Abstract: Transformers have shown promising performance in LLMs due to their outstanding scalability, several studies have investigated the scalability of Transformers for industrial recommendation. They typically rely on a single ranking model to optimize both sparse and dense parameters from scratch, resulting in substantial computational resource consumption and slow convergence. Fortunately, the pre-training models offer an effective solution to the above issues by providing favorable initialization of both sparse and dense parameters for the subsequent ranking. However, they still face two major limitations: (1) Since the input features used in pre-training and ranking are usually inconsistent, directly transferring dense parameters from pre-training to ranking may lead to negative transfer. (2) Multi-epoch training during the ranking process may result in the overfitting of sparse parameters, while freezing the sparse parameters limits their adaptability to the ranking objectives. To this end, we propose a Scaling Transformer for Industrial Recommendation via Transferable Generative Pre-training, termed LazFormer. Specifically, we first present a generative pre-training module to autoregressively generate sequential features, providing favorable initialization of both sparse and dense parameters for the subsequent ranking. To solve the negative transfer of dense parameters, we propose a transferable residual adapter that injects additional ranking-specific features into ranking in a residual manner. Moreover, a request-aware ranking module integrates long-sequence compression, hybrid sparse attention, and a request-aware paradigm to efficiently model users' long sequences. Besides, we further propose an asymmetric multi-epoch training strategy that resets sparse parameters while continuously accumulating dense parameters across epochs, alleviating the overfitting of sparse parameters.

</details>


### [486] [Generate to Explore, Select to Exploit: Aligning LLM-based Headline Generation with Personalized Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15094)
*Yi Chen,Rufeng Cheng,Qiang Xie,Tao Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: GESE框架通过将个性化解耦为生成式探索与选择式利用两阶段，利用LLM生成多样化候选标题集合，再经轻量级选择器实时选取最优标题，在亿级DAU商业平台上显著提升CTR 2.57%与停留时长0.87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐流中静态标题无法满足用户多样化、多模态兴趣，尤其忽视长尾受众需求；直接微调LLM输出单一最佳标题易导致模式崩塌，收敛于迎合大众口味的通用模式，错失特定潜在意图。

Method: 提出GESE（Generate to Explore, Select to Exploit）双阶段框架：1) 探索阶段：将LLM视为概率探索器，采用分组序列策略优化（GSPO）配合分层奖励机制，生成最大化语义覆盖的候选标题集合；2) 利用阶段：轻量级实时反馈感知选择器依据即时上下文信号，从候选池中精准选出最优呈现。

Result: 在日活超亿的商业平台大规模部署实验表明，GESE显著优于SOTA基线，CTR提升2.57%，停留时长提升0.87%，验证了将多样性导向生成与精准度导向选择解耦的有效性。

Conclusion: GESE为生成式AI与动态用户效用对齐提供了稳健蓝图，证明在呈现层解耦探索与利用能有效缓解模式崩塌，兼顾长尾兴趣覆盖与实时个性化精准度。

Abstract: In industrial recommendation feeds, presenting a static headline for an item often fails to satisfy the diverse, multimodal interests of the user population, particularly suppressing the needs of long-tail audiences. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have been integrated into recommendation for content understanding or ranking, directly optimizing them to output a single best headline typically leads to mode collapse---converging to generic patterns that satisfy average tastes but miss specific latent intents. To bridge this gap, we introduce GESE (Generate to Explore, Select to Exploit), a framework operating at the system's presentation layer that decouples personalization into generative exploration and selective exploitation. First, we treat the LLM as a probabilistic explorer, utilizing Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) with a hierarchical reward mechanism to generate a candidate set that maximizes the semantic coverage of potential user interests. Subsequently, a lightweight, real-time feedback-aware selector acts as the exploiter, identifying the optimal realization from the candidate pool based on instant contextual signals. Extensive deployment on a commercial platform with over 100 million daily active users demonstrates that GESE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 2.57% lift in CTR and 0.87% in dwell time. These results validate that decoupling diversity-oriented generation from precision-oriented selection offers a robust blueprint for aligning generative AI with dynamic user utility.

</details>


### [487] [Top-K Is Not a Budget for Hybrid Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15143)
*Chunran Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 DiBud，一种基于访问预算的混合检索融合方法，能够增量认证并返回 RRF 排名的精确前缀，在保持检索质量的同时大幅降低访问成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合检索通常融合密集和稀疏检索器的 Top-L 结果，但固定截断深度难以适应变化的查询和语料库；精确融合虽消除固定深度依赖，但完成指定 Top-K 仍产生可变的访问成本，且存在长尾分布。

Method: DiBud 直接以访问预算为输入，通过选择性访问增量认证 RRF 排名的精确前缀，并采用预算停止机制限制每次请求的访问次数，实现在预算内最大化认证输出。

Result: 在五个查询集上实验显示，预算 2048 时 DiBud 比均衡访问在前 100 位平均认证输出提升 7.86%；经 95% 质量保留校准后，保留查询保持 95.05%-97.68% 的平均 nDCG@20，同时访问量减少 65.92%-99.53%。

Conclusion: DiBud 通过预算感知的增量融合有效解决了混合检索中的访问成本不可控问题，在显著降低计算开销的同时保持了高检索质量，适用于实际 RAG 系统的部署。

Abstract: Modern hybrid retrieval for RAG typically fuses the Top-$L$ results from dense and sparse retrievers, but a fixed truncation depth may not transfer across changing queries and corpora. Exact fusion removes the dependence on a fixed depth, yet completing a specified Top-$K$ still incurs variable access costs. We present DiBud, which takes an access budget directly as input and incrementally certifies and returns an exact prefix of the RRF ranking over the full lists. Selective access increases certified output within the budget, while budgeted stopping bounds accesses per request. Experiments on five query sets reveal long-tailed costs for completing exact Top-20. At a budget of 2048 accesses, DiBud increases mean certified output within the first 100 positions by 7.86% over balanced access. After budget calibration for 95% quality retention, held-out queries retain 95.05%--97.68% of mean nDCG@20 while using 65.92%--99.53% fewer accesses than completing exact Top-20.

</details>


### [488] [ProLiVis 2.0: Literature-Centric Visualization of Protein--Protein Interaction Networks, with a Citation-Trust Model for Interaction Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15236)
*Melih Sözdinler,Yalçın Doksanbir,Gökhan Akpınar,Ege Aktan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ProLiVis 2.0 是一个基于文献的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用可视化系统，引入了引用信任模型对相互作用进行评分，采用确定性的中心布局算法，并实现为纯浏览器端应用，揭示了 BioGRID 中大多数 SARS-CoV-2 相互作用仅基于单一文献且未经复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用数据库（如 BioGRID）不区分证据强度，将高通量筛选得到的单次相互作用与多实验室多实验验证的相互作用同等对待，导致构建的网络无法反映交互的可信度。

Method: 1. 引用信任模型：从七个术语为每个相互作用评分，包括通过聚合共享机构隶属关系的出版物来计算独立实验室数量的术语。2. 确定性中心布局：闭式解、O(n log n) 复杂度，替代原力导向布局，使图形可从会话清单重现。3. 纯 Web 实现：嵌入式分析数据库，无需安装，不上传数据。

Result: 在 BioGRID 5.0.260 版本的 SARS-CoV-2 数据中，34,540 个报告的相互作用中有 24,344 个（70%）仅基于单一文献；将信任阈值提高到 0.2 后仅保留 11,320 个。现有数据库视图无法直观展示这一大多数相互作用未经复现的事实。

Conclusion: ProLiVis 2.0 通过信任感知的可视化，使未经复现的相互作用变得可见，为蛋白质相互作用网络的可靠性评估提供了新工具。

Abstract: Protein-protein interaction databases record evidence without weighing it. In BioGRID, an interaction asserted once by a single high-throughput screen and one confirmed by twenty laboratories across a dozen assays are the same kind of row in the same file. Tools built on such databases inherit that flattening: they draw every reported interaction as an edge, and the resulting picture states that two proteins interact without stating how much anyone should believe it.
  We present ProLiVis 2.0, a rewrite of the literature-centric visualization system of arXiv:2111.12794. It contributes three things. First, a citation-trust model that scores each interaction from seven terms, including a term for the number of independent laboratories behind the supporting publications, obtained by clustering those publications over shared institutional affiliations; a plain count of publications cannot distinguish five confirmations from one group publishing five times. Second, a deterministic reformulation of the center layout, closed-form and $O(n \log n)$, which replaces the force-directed placement of the original and makes published figures regenerable from a session manifest. Third, an implementation that runs entirely in a web browser, with an embedded analytical database, requiring no installation and uploading no data.
  On BioGRID release 5.0.260 restricted to SARS-CoV-2, 24,344 of 34,540 reported interactions (70%) rest on a single publication, and raising the trust threshold to 0.2 leaves 11,320 of them. That the large majority of a curated interaction network is unreplicated is a fact no existing view of the database makes visible.

</details>


### [489] [Clean Scores, Buried Evidence, and Confident Wrong: A Receipt-Based Audit of Frontier Agentic QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15319)
*Luis M. Sánchez*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文通过受控数据室审计实验，揭示前沿模型在深层证据检索任务中表现下降，且置信度校准无法捕捉编造的结构性主张；主张智能体评估需采用声明级溯源、条件感知评分和人类对抗验证，将举证责任从模型转移到证据链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基准测试主要关注浅层文档/图表阅读任务，无法反映模型在复杂金融尽职调查等场景中面对深埋证据时的真实表现，且模型可能将准确数字与自信编造的解释结合，导致签署者承担风险。

Method: 采用受控数据室审计实验，将证据置于“深埋条件” 中，测量模型准确率、强制声明率、工具调用次数及每正确答案成本；分析置信度与基准校准对错误答案的捕捉能力；记录生产环境中编造结构性主张与准确数值表混合的事件。

Result: 深埋证据显著降低准确率，增加强制声明、工具调用和成本；置信度和基准校准未能完全捕捉错误答案；发现模型能将准确数字与自信编造的结构性主张结合。

Conclusion: 智能体评估需从排行榜转向审计学科，采用声明级溯源、条件感知评分和人类对抗验证；举证责任必须从模型转移到证据链，以应对金融尽职调查和国防参谋工作等高风险场景。

Abstract: Frontier models score well on shallow document/chart reading tasks. In a controlled data-room audit, moving evidence into buried conditions reduced accuracy, increased forced declarations, increased tool calls, and increased cost per correct answer. Confidence and benchmark calibration did not fully capture wrong answers; a documented production incident shows fabricated structural claims can be mixed with accurate numeric tables. Agentic evaluations need claim-level receipts (statement-level provenance, not answer-level scores), condition-aware scoring, and human-adversarial verification - an auditing discipline, not a leaderboard. The setting we measure is financial due diligence; the setting we are building toward next is defense staff work, where the same buried-evidence shape appears. In both, the model is not a party to the consequences; the person who signs is. In plain terms: in the documented cases we examine, agents can pair accurate numbers with confident fabricated explanations, and the burden of proof must therefore move from the model to the evidence trail.

</details>


### [490] [Benchmarking Embedding Models for ESG Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15434)
*Motaz Saad,Veronica Cretì,Ivan Gentile,Kianna Kazemi,Antonella Longo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文构建了ESG领域专用基准数据集，评测了14个嵌入模型在检索和RAG任务上的表现，发现Qwen3系列模型整体性能最优，为ESG领域RAG应用提供了模型选型指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ESG数据对企业问责、可持续性报告和金融决策至关重要，嵌入模型虽被广泛用于将非结构化ESG文本转为数值表示，但其在ESG特定任务上的有效性尚未系统研究，亟需针对性基准评测。

Method: 构建ESG领域专用基准数据集；选取14个开源与闭源嵌入模型；在检索任务和检索增强生成（RAG）任务上进行全面基准测试与对比。

Result: 不同模型在ESG任务上表现差异显著；基于Qwen3的模型在整体性能上达到最高，为ESG检索与RAG应用提供了最佳选择。

Conclusion: 研究填补了ESG领域嵌入模型系统评测的空白，确立了Qwen3系列模型在ESG RAG任务中的优势地位，为实际部署提供了实证依据。

Abstract: The use of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) data is fundamental for modern corporate accountability, sustainability reporting, and financial decision-making. Embedding models have emerged as a powerful approach for transforming unstructured ESG text into numerical representations suitable for downstream natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, their effectiveness in these ESG-specific tasks has not been systematically studied. In this paper, we construct a benchmark dataset specifically tailored to the ESG domain. We benchmark fourteen models, both open-source and closed-source embedding models, comparing their performance with respect to retrieval, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The results demonstrate performance variations across different models, with Qwen3-based models achieving the highest overall performance. This study provides practical insights into which models are better suited for ESG RAG tasks.

</details>


### [491] [Beyond Retrieval: Scaffolding Children's Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15568)
*Diletta Micol Tobia,Hrishita Chakrabarti,Maria Soledad Pera,Monica Landoni*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对儿童使用面向成人设计的在线信息检索系统时面临的理解缺失问题，提出将儿童定位为搜索过程中的主动参与者，将搜索重构为脚手架式学习体验，而非单纯的检索任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童越来越多地使用主要为主流人群（如成人）设计的在线信息获取系统，但对这些系统的工作原理理解有限，导致其搜索实践无结构且低效，这种知识缺乏会阻碍儿童的好奇心发展和批判性搜索技能的培养。

Method: 基于面向儿童的信息检索（IR）和人机交互（HCI）现有文献，采用理论框架构建方法，将儿童定位为搜索过程的主动参与者，引入脚手架学习理论，将搜索过程重新框架化为支持技能发展的学习体验。

Result: 提出了一种以儿童为中心的搜索范式转变：从单纯的信息检索任务转向脚手架式学习体验，为设计支持儿童搜索素养发展的系统提供了理论基础。

Conclusion: 未来的信息检索系统设计应将儿童视为主动学习者，通过脚手架机制支持其搜索技能的渐进式发展，而非仅优化检索效率，这有助于培养儿童的批判性思维和信息素养。

Abstract: Children increasingly turn to online information access systems that are primarily designed for the mainstream population, e.g., adults, but possess a limited understanding of how these systems work, contributing to their unstructured and ineffective search practices. This lack of knowledge can hinder their curiosity and the development of critical search skills. Grounded on the existing literature of both child-oriented Information Retrieval and Human Computer Interaction, our work positions children as active participants in the search process, framing it as a scaffolded learning experience rather than a simple retrieval task.

</details>


### [492] [The Magnitude Mirage: Rethinking Confidence for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15578)
*Jamie Holdcroft,Abdelrahman Abdallah,Adam Jatowt*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文揭示了RAG系统中基于原始相似度分数幅度的检索弃权机制在需要逻辑和时间推理的查询上系统性失效（称为“幅度幻觉”），并提出采用零成本的分数分布信号（如Score Gap和LSMV）替代幅度阈值，显著提升弃权AUROC，无需额外推理或重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统普遍使用原始相似度分数幅度作为置信度信号进行检索弃权，但研究发现神经检索器会给语义相关但违反约束的文档分配高分，导致基于幅度的阈值在逻辑推理和时间推理任务上退化为近随机性能，这一现象被称为“幅度幻觉”。

Method: 在11种检索架构和28个数据集上进行大规模实证研究，评估六个零成本查询性能预测（QPP）指标，跨越三个认知层级：语义匹配（BEIR）、逻辑推理（BRIGHT）、时间推理（TEMPO）。重点对比基于分数幅度与基于分数分布的信号。

Result: 放弃幅度转而使用分数分布信号带来的提升是分布替代方案间差异的5-10倍。Score Gap (s1 - sk) 和改进的LSMV 在幅度置信力失效的设置中将弃权AUROC提升高达0.16。这些方法零成本、无需额外推理、重训练或延迟。

Conclusion: 基于分数分布的QPP指标（特别是Score Gap和LSMV）是部署RAG系统中幅度阈值的实用零成本替代方案，能有效缓解“幅度幻觉”问题，显著提升需要推理的查询的检索弃权性能。

Abstract: Many production RAG systems implement retrieval abstention by thresholding raw similarity scores, implicitly treating score magnitude as a confidence signal. We demonstrate that this practice degrades systematically as queries require reasoning beyond semantic matching. Across 11 retrieval architectures and 28 datasets, neural retrievers consistently assign high similarity scores to semantically related but constraint-violating documents, causing magnitude-based thresholds to collapse toward near-random abstention performance on logical and temporal reasoning tasks---a failure we term the Magnitude Mirage. To address this without computationally expensive alternatives, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of six zero-cost Query Performance Prediction (QPP) metrics across three cognitive tiers: semantic matching (BEIR), logical reasoning (BRIGHT), and temporal reasoning (TEMPO). Our central finding is that the key improvement comes from abandoning magnitude in favor of score-distribution signals: the gain from this shift exceeds the differences among distributional alternatives by a factor of 5-10$\times$. In particular, Score Gap ($s_1 - s_k$) and a practical adaptation of Score Magnitude and Variance (LSMV) improve abstention AUROC by up to 0.16 in settings where magnitude-based confidence provides little discriminative power. These methods require no additional inference, retraining, or latency, making them a practical zero-cost replacement for magnitude thresholding in deployed RAG systems.

</details>


### [493] [Self-Evolving Memory for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15598)
*Xinyu Lin,Zhuosong Jiang,Zixiao Suo,Siqin Wang,Hanqing Zeng,Hanchao Yu,Yinglong Xia,Jiang Zhang,Aashu Singh,Fei Liu,Wenjie Wang,Fuli Feng,Yang Song,Qifan Wang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出LION框架，通过稀疏Key-Value记忆层解决生成式推荐中的演化冲突问题，实现异构用户偏好的有效自演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐作为端到端范式虽具潜力，但用户偏好持续演化，现有持续训练和蒸馏适应策略直接更新共享参数，导致演化冲突：主导行为模式主导模型演化，少数模式被忽视。

Method: 提出自演化记忆范式，遵循隔离记忆、强化演化、可扩展应用三原则。开发LION框架：稀疏Key-Value记忆层，稀疏记忆激活隔离不同行为模式演化，巩固损失强化少数偏好动态学习。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上验证，LION在各类持续演化设置（周期评估、用户/物品组评估、演化收敛分析）均表现优异。

Conclusion: LION通过稀疏记忆机制有效解决生成式推荐的演化冲突，为自演化推荐系统提供了简单有效的解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Generative recommendation has emerged as a promising end-to-end paradigm for personalized recommendation. However, user preferences continuously evolve over time, making self-evolving an essential capability for generative recommender systems. Existing evolving strategies, such as continual retraining and distillation-based adaptation, directly update the shared model parameters using streaming interactions. Nevertheless, we find that directly applying such strategies to generative recommendation introduces a critical issue, termed evolution conflict. Specifically, heterogeneous preference shifts from different users are optimized within a fully shared autoregressive parameter space, causing dominant behavioral patterns to progressively dominate the model evolution process while underrepresented patterns become increasingly overlooked. To address this issue, we propose a self-evolving memory paradigm for generative recommendation, aiming to enable effective evolution across heterogeneous behavioral patterns. We further identify three key principles for effective self-evolving recommendation systems, including isolated memorization, reinforced evolution, and scalable application. Guided by these principles, we develop LION, a simple yet effective framework centered on a sparse Key-Value memory layer. Specifically, LION introduces sparse memory activation to isolate the evolution of different behavioral patterns, while a consolidation loss is designed to reinforce the learning of underrepresented preference dynamics during continual adaptation. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of LION under various continual evolution settings (e.g., per-period evaluation, user/item group evaluation, and evolution convergence analysis). The codes are released at https://github.com/JazyJiang/Self-Evolving-Memory-for-Generative-Recommendation.

</details>


### [494] [IROH: Insightful Ranking Of Humor using Multi-Stage Hybrid Retrieval with Rationale-Distilled LLM Judges for JOKER 2026 Track Task 1 English](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15618)
*Ana-Maria Luisa Mocanu,Sebastian Mocanu,Ciprian-Octavian Truică,Elena-Simona Apostol*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: VANGUARD团队提出IROH三阶段检索系统，在CLEF 2026 JOKER Task 1英语任务中获第一，MAP 0.6347。系统结合混合稀疏-稠密检索、交叉编码器重排序、LoRA适配的大语言模型评判集成。使用Gemma 4生成查询感知理由（通用和类型化两种提示策略），构建多达四种结构化难负样本。消融实验揭示三个关键发现：理由蒸馏评判器是排名质量主要驱动力，将理由追加到一阶索引贡献微乎其微；结构化难负样本在几乎所有配置中损害泛化尽管提升局部验证分数；更轻量、校准更好的模型与更大模型竞争或更强，通用理由Qwen2.5-7B评判器（0.6055 MAP）超越所有Gemma-4-31B配置，通用理由优势几乎集中在较小模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对幽默检索任务，需要有效排名幽默内容，现有方法可能在理解幽默细微差别、生成相关理由、构建高质量训练数据方面存在不足。旨在通过结合混合检索、交叉编码器重排序和大模型评判集成，提升幽默检索性能，并探究理由蒸馏、难负样本构建、模型规模与校准对排名质量的影响。

Method: 三阶段流水线：第一阶段混合稀疏-稠密检索；第二阶段交叉编码器重排序；第三阶段LoRA适配的大语言模型评判集成。使用Gemma 4生成查询感知理由，采用通用和类型化两种提示策略。构建多达四种结构化难负样本用于训练数据增强。对三种交叉编码器架构、四种稠密嵌入器、八种评判器配置进行消融实验。

Result: 在CLEF 2026 JOKER Task 1英语任务中获得第一，MAP 0.6347。消融发现：理由蒸馏评判器是排名质量主要驱动力，将理由追加到一阶索引贡献可忽略；结构化难负样本在几乎所有配置中降低泛化性能，尽管提高了局部验证分数；更轻量、校准更好的模型（Qwen2.5-7B通用理由评判器，0.6055 MAP）优于所有Gemma-4-31B配置，通用理由优于类型化理由的优势几乎完全集中在较小模型上。

Conclusion: IROH系统通过理由蒸馏评判器显著提升幽默检索排名质量，结构化难负样本虽提升验证分数但损害泛化，轻量级模型在良好校准下可超越更大模型，通用理由策略在较小模型中更有效。这些发现为幽默检索及类似任务提供了重要指导：重点应放在评判器理由蒸馏而非索引扩展，避免过度依赖结构化难负样本，选择适度规模且校准良好的模型。

Abstract: Our team, VANGUARD, presents IROH (Insightful Ranking of Humor), a three-stage retrieval system for JOKER Task 1 English at CLEF 2026, achieving first place on the leaderboard with 0.6347 MAP. Our pipeline combines hybrid sparse-dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and a LoRA-adapted Large Language Model judge ensemble. We employ Gemma 4 to generate query-aware rationales under two prompt strategies, generic and typed, and produce up to four types of structured hard negatives for training data construction. Through an ablation across three cross-encoder architectures, four dense embedders, and eight judge configurations, our key findings are threefold: (1) the rationale-distilled judge is the primary driver of ranking quality, whereas appending rationales to the first-stage index contributes negligibly; (2) structured hard negatives degrade generalisation in nearly all configurations despite inflating local validation scores; and (3) across the components we ablate, the lighter, better-calibrated model is competitive with or stronger than its larger counterpart, with the generic-rationale Qwen2.5-7B judge (0.6055 MAP) outperforming every Gemma-4-31B configuration, and the advantage of generic over typed rationales is concentrated almost entirely in the smaller model.

</details>
